action.command: echo "=== m2 repo size ==="; du -sh /root/.m2 2>/dev/null; echo "=== build logs ==="; ls -la /workspace/*.log /tmp/*.log 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 3 -name "*.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "mvn|build|install" | head; echo "=== target summary dirs ==="; ls /workspace/target 2>/dev/null; echo "=== module count in pom ==="; grep -c "<module>" /workspace/pom.xml
